title: d-Spectral Bitopological Spaces
summary: We introduce and study the category of \emph{d-spectral spaces}, a bitopological analogue of the classical spectral spaces of Stone and Hochster. A d-spectral space is a compact, d-sober bitopological space such that both open set lattices are coherent frames, where d-sobriety is the bitopological notion of sobriety due to Jung and Moshier. We show that the category of spectral spaces embeds into the category of d-spectral spaces as a simultaneously reflective and coreflective full subcategory.
